movelist.name: Crunch
movelist.effect: Crunch lowers the target’s Defense 1 Combat Stage on 17+

movelist.name: Scary Face
movelist.effect: The target’s Speed is lowered 2 Combat Stages.

movelist.name: High Jump Kick
movelist.effect: If High Jump Kick misses, the user loses Hit Points equal to 1/4th of their Max Hit Points. A failure to hit due to a Move with the Shield keyword does not count as a miss. This Move cannot be used if Gravity is in effect.

movelist.name: Chip Away
movelist.effect: Ignore any Armor, Damage Reduction, or changes in the target’s Defense or Special Defense (such as from Combat Stages) when calculating damage.

movelist.name: Payback
movelist.effect: If the target hit the user with a Damaging Move on the previous turn, Payback has a Damage Base of 10 (3d8+10 / 24) instead.

movelist.name: Brick Break
movelist.effect: Light Screen and Reflect may not be activated in response to Brick Break.

abilities.name: Moxie
abilities.effect: Whenever the user’s Move causes a target to faint, it may raise its Attack Combat Stage by +1. You may only trigger Moxie once per Move, even if the Move causes multiple targets to faint.

abilities.name: Intimidate
abilities.effect: Lower the target’s Attack 1 Combat Stage. You may target a specific foe only once per Scene with Intimidate.

abilities.name: Bully
abilities.trigger: The user hits a target for Super-Effective
abilities.effect: The target of the attack is pushed 2 Meters, becomes Tripped, and gains an Injury.
